captions.detailed: A road-bike triple crankset featuring a central hollowtech outboard-bearing spindle in dark gray/black, carrying three concentric chainrings of varying diameters with detailed outer teeth. Two light-gray aluminum crank arms extend in opposite directions (180 degrees apart), each terminating in a sleek, black rectangular clipless pedal. The left crank arm is clamped to the spindle end with a small pre-load cap, while the right arm integrates directly into the spider of the chainrings.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a road-bike triple crankset with three concentric, toothed chainrings mounted on a central outboard-bearing spindle, dual opposing light-gray crank arms, and rectangular black clipless pedals on each end.
captions.factory: Construct the spindle using a central cylinder primitive. Create the three chainrings as thin disks of varying radii, adding patterned perimeter notches or teeth, and arrange them concentrically. Model the crank arms by extruding rectangular profiles with filleted ends, positioning them 180 degrees apart on either end of the spindle. Model the pedals as flat rectangular boxes with central axle cutouts, and attach them to the outer ends of the crank arms.
